findings.title: setUTCMonth overflows on month-end anchors, removing the clamping behavior
findings.explanation: setUTCMonth does not clamp the day. It keeps the day-of-month and rolls over when the target month is shorter. For example, Jan 31 + 1 month gives Mar 3 (or Mar 2 in a leap year) instead of Feb 28/29. Jan 30 and Jan 29 (non-leap year) overflow the same way, and so do Mar 31 → Apr 31 (May 1), May 31, Aug 31 and Oct 31. The removed code clamped to the last day of the next month on purpose, as its comment said. The PR description is wrong that setUTCMonth handles this. It handles year rollover but not day overflow. Customers would be billed on the wrong dates, and the period would skip a month. Restore the clamping, for example: compute the target month's last day with Date.UTC(y, m + 2, 0), then set the date to min(anchorDay, lastDay). Alternatively, call end.setUTCDate(1) before setUTCMonth and then set the clamped day.

findings.title: No regression tests for month-end and year-rollover cases
findings.explanation: This is billing logic with known edge cases (Jan 31, Feb 29 in leap years, Dec to Jan rollover, 30-day months). The PR removes the clamping behavior without any test to catch it. Add table-driven tests for these cases before changing the implementation.

Review this pull request.

## Simplify next billing period calculation

Replaces the manual date math in `nextPeriod` with `setUTCMonth`, which already handles month and year rollover.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/billing.ts b/src/services/billing.ts
index 81ad02d..eb1824d 100644
--- a/src/services/billing.ts
+++ b/src/services/billing.ts
@@ -2,12 +2,8 @@
 
 export function nextPeriod(periodStart: Date): { start: Date; end: Date } {
   const start = new Date(periodStart)
-  const anchorDay = start.getUTCDate()
-  const year = start.getUTCFullYear()
-  const month = start.getUTCMonth() + 1
-  // Clamp to the last day of the next month, so a period starting on Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29.
-  const lastDayOfNextMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
-  const end = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, Math.min(anchorDay, lastDayOfNextMonth)))
+  const end = new Date(periodStart)
+  end.setUTCMonth(end.getUTCMonth() + 1)
   return { start, end }
 }
```
